purpose: Independent additional p3 reference pool on the existing 96 evaluation graphs

reference_search.stopping_rule: Complete all 100 new starts per graph; prefix and half-pool diagnostics do not trigger early stopping or automatic extension.
reference_search.scope: prepare inserts exact reference_graph_ids; only reference tasks are generated. Existing training graphs, references and evaluation runs are read-only.
reference_search.interpretation: A stronger empirical reference, never a certificate of the global QAOA optimum. Known evaluation scores are diagnostics only, never reference candidates.
